Windows console fixes, and packages for more platforms. Same API and ABI as
0.1.1.

### Fixes

All found by hand in a Windows 11 VM, in conhost, Windows Terminal, WezTerm,
Alacritty, mintty and VS Code:

- The Windows console (conhost) now shows every row of an inline frame. It
  used to show only the first one and push the others past the right edge.
- Apps no longer print `←[?2004h` when they start and `←[?2004l` when they
  quit in the Windows console. Bracketed paste is now turned on and off
  together with the raw mode.
- Pressing Shift, Ctrl or Alt on its own in conhost no longer freezes the
  app, its animations and timers until the next key.
- conhost draws with a single font, and Consolas lacks glyphs RTXUI uses
  (`border: tall`, rounded corners). The screen now asks the font which
  glyphs it has and replaces each missing one with the closest it has.
  `RTXUI_GLYPHS=full` turns this off, `RTXUI_GLYPHS=basic` forces it.
  Windows Terminal and other pseudoconsole hosts fall back to other fonts
  and are left alone.

The input of these six Windows terminals is now recorded and replayed by the
unit tests, like the Linux ones.

### Packages

| File | What it holds |
| :--- | :--- |
| `rtxui-0.1.2-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Debug and Release static libraries, headers, CMake package, pkg-config file |
| `rtxui-0.1.2-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | The same, for arm64 (new) |
| `rtxui-0.1.2-macos-universal.tar.gz` | The same, for arm64 and x86_64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.2-windows-x64.zip` | The same, built with MSVC (`/MD` runtime; `rtxuid.lib` for Debug) |
| `rtxui-0.1.2-windows-arm64.zip` | The same, for arm64 (new) |
| `rtxui-0.1.2-windows-x64-mingw.zip` | The same, built with MinGW-w64 GCC, UCRT, as MSYS2's UCRT64 (new) |
| `librtxui-dev_0.1.2_amd64.deb`, `librtxui-dev_0.1.2_arm64.deb` | Release library for Debian and Ubuntu |
| `rtxui-devel-0.1.2-1.x86_64.rpm`, `rtxui-devel-0.1.2-1.aarch64.rpm` | Release library for Fedora and other RPM distributions |
| `rtxui-0.1.2.tar.gz` | The source, as committed |

Before publishing, the release installs each .deb on Ubuntu 24.04 and each
.rpm on Fedora, and builds an app against each archive with
`find_package(rtxui)`, in Debug and in Release.

A prebuilt static C++ library links with a compatible compiler and standard
library: GCC or Clang with libstdc++ on Linux, Apple Clang on macOS, MSVC or
MinGW (UCRT) on Windows, each with its own archive. Otherwise, build from
source with FetchContent, as described in
[Getting started](https://arthursonzogni.github.io/RTXUI/guide/getting-started).
